history.text: The Almoravid movement began among Sanhaja Berbers in the region.
Caravan towns such as Chinguetti served trans-Saharan trade and pilgrimage.
Mauritania became the last country in the world to formally abolish slavery.

worthSeeing.title: Chinguetti:
worthSeeing.text: A caravan town with surviving desert libraries, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Banc d'Arguin:
worthSeeing.text: A coastal park of vast wader flocks, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Richat Structure:
worthSeeing.text: A 40 km circular formation in the Sahara, visible from orbit.
